title: FlowCyPy: Flow Cytometry Simulation Framework
description: FlowCyPy is an open-source physics-based simulation framework for flow cytometry. It models the measurement chain from particle populations and hydrodynamic focusing through Mie theory-based light scattering, photodetection, noise, analog signal conditioning, digitization, and discriminator-based event detection. The framework is designed particularly for quantitative simulation and analysis of extracellular-vesicle-scale flow cytometry measurements.
